subject.summary: Ferrari F40, 1987 two-seat berlinetta. Dimension-scaled three-view reconstruction; traced body and fitted details are inferred, not a factory CAD model. No photographic artwork. All rendered surfaces are inferred from the private reference photographs and patent elevations; only the cited dimensional facts are verified.

sources.title: F40 original patent side view, Fioravanti US D306274, crop origin (620,270); checked against private F40 Seitenansicht photograph
Full-size Ferrari F40 overhead photograph reproduced for comparison by Eric Albrecht, Technicopedia (over1, not the over2 RC model)
Ferrari F40 US D306274 original front elevation; private crop origin (645,975)
F40 Seitenansicht, Wikimedia Commons; private broadside photograph
1990 Ferrari F40 2.9 Front, Wikimedia Commons; private front three-quarter photograph
F40 elevated rear view, photograph credited to mycatkins; private reference

facts.value: Side and front patent elevations plus overhead photograph reconciled to official dimensions; wing separated from the body loft; cockpit and wheel apertures fitted to the traced stations.
Animated holographic study, not factory CAD

identity.feature: Low wide wedge, steep swept windscreen and compact roof
Integrated high rear wing with raked endplates and open gap
Five-spoke center-lock wheels and low-profile tyres
Twin bonnet NACA ducts, closed popup lids and clear fixed headlights
High side cooling inlet, lower NACA duct and dark belt line
Sloping Lexan engine cover with twin banks of louvres
Four round tail lamps, tail vents and three central exhausts
Readable bucket seats, dashboard, steering wheel and parked windscreen wiper
